description: This file defines the Supervisor Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for normalizing supervisor information related to an employee, retrieving supervisor details, and mapping fields for reporting purposes.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing supervisor information linked to an employee, enabling normalization and retrieval of supervisor details for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Supervisor DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the supervisor data to an array format based on specified fields.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Retrieves specific fields from the Employee or ReportingMethod entities, especially for the 'supReportingMethod' field.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to getter methods for normalization.
